name: ExpandInPlaceCard
job: A compact card that smoothly grows to a larger layout in place, nudging neighbours aside, to reveal full description and a link
visitor_action: click/tap the card or press Enter on the round control to expand; Esc or clicking again collapses
mobile: expands to full width inline and scrolls into view
motion: hero morph: the photo springs from an asymmetric arched panel into a full-bleed stage while the card grows, then the details row opens and the words cascade in with stagger (reduced-motion: instant, static)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Harbour slate: cool grey-blue panels, crisp white type, one signal-orange accent, matte soft-radius surfaces
notes: 2026-11-23: quality redo 2 (Sonnet 5.5, QA fail). Rebuilt as a composed hero with a clip-path morph and word-stagger; photo has an always-on CSS-painted harbour fallback. Relies on clip-path/grid-row interpolation, so old browsers snap between states. 2026-11-23: composition round 2: collapsed state is now a near-full-bleed arched photo with a display-size headline overlapping it, chart rings and compass ticks in the margin, and a machined steel button seated in a bite on the card edge; expand unfurls the arch to full bleed, shrinks the headline, then cascades the details. Known weakness: summary can straddle the arch edge at mid widths; wide layout is fixed-composition (arch/bite) so it assumes a container of about 640px or more, below that it switches to a dome layout.
